name: Orcs Hands ON!
summary:
Your Orcs have big dreams. Questionable plans. And you.

Build their village, grow stronger, and uncover a mysterious island’s secrets in **Orcs Hands ON!** — a fantasy VR adventure with RPG upgrades, idle progression, and hands-on fun.

You’re the Chieftain of a lovable crew of would-be conquerors. After a storm leaves you shipwrecked, turn their new home into a thriving village and lead your Battle Orcs into danger. What was that strange green light that brought you here?

**Built for hand tracking:** cho
